hooks.command: root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; br=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); git fetch --prune --quiet 2>/dev/null || { jq -n --arg b "$br" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Git: no se pudo hacer fetch (¿sin red?). Norma .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md: hazlo a mano antes de empezar. Rama: " + $b)}}'; exit 0; }; up=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null) || { jq -n --arg b "$br" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Git: la rama " + $b + " no tiene upstream. Norma .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md.")}}'; exit 0; }; ahead=$(git rev-list --count "$up"..HEAD); behind=$(git rev-list --count HEAD.."$up"); dirty=$(git status --porcelain | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$behind" = 0 ]; then msg="Git: $br al día con $up (ahead $ahead)."; elif [ "$ahead" = 0 ] && [ "$dirty" = 0 ]; then git pull --ff-only --quiet 2>/dev/null && msg="Git: $br avanzada $behind commits hasta $(git rev-parse --short HEAD) (fast-forward)." || msg="Git: $br está $behind commits detrás de $up y el pull --ff-only falló."; elif [ "$ahead" != 0 ]; then msg="Git: $br ha DIVERGIDO de $up (ahead $ahead, behind $behind). No hagas pull a secas: git cherry $up $br y decide según .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md."; else msg="Git: $br está $behind commits detrás de $up pero el árbol tiene $dirty ficheros sin commitear; no se hizo pull."; fi; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:($m + " Norma: .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md.")}}'

git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; gh issue list --state open --limit 30 --json number,title --jq '.[] | "#\(.number) \(.title)"' 2>/dev/null | jq -Rs 'if . == "" then {} else {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"SessionStart",additionalContext:("Issues abiertos de este repo. Norma: .claude/rules/issues-abiertos.md — léelos antes de empezar y cita en el plan los que afecten a la tarea.\n" + .)}} end'

jq -r ".tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path // empty" | { read -r f; case "$f" in ""|*/.env|/tmp/*|/private/tmp/*) exit 0;; esac; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; hits=$(grep -n -m 3 -E "/Users/[A-Za-z0-9_-]|/Volumes/[A-Za-z0-9_-]|192\.168\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+" "$f") || exit 0; jq -n --arg f "$f" --arg h "$hits" '{decision:"block",reason:("Ruta absoluta de usuario, share o IP en " + $f + " — normas .claude/rules/sin-rutas-absolutas.md y repo-publico.md: usa $HOME, /archive, /config o una variable documentada en .env.example.\n" + $h)}'; }

jq -r ".message // \"Claude Code te espera\"" | { read -r m; osascript -e 'on run argv' -e 'display notification (item 1 of argv) with title "MHL Sentinel" sound name "Submarine"' -e 'end run' "$m" >/dev/null 2>&1; }

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; cd "$root" || exit 0; git remote get-url origin >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; br=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$br" ] && [ "$br" != HEAD ] || exit 0; if up=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{u} 2>/dev/null); then ahead=$(git rev-list --count "$up"..HEAD); [ "$ahead" != 0 ] || exit 0; out=$(git push --quiet 2>&1) && msg="Git: push de $br ($ahead commits) a $up." || msg="Git: el push de $br FALLÓ: $(echo "$out" | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' ') — norma .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md."; else out=$(git push --quiet -u origin "$br" 2>&1) && msg="Git: push de $br con upstream nuevo en origin." || msg="Git: el push -u de $br FALLÓ: $(echo "$out" | tail -2 | tr '\n' ' ') — norma .claude/rules/pull-y-push.md."; fi; jq -n --arg m "$msg" '{systemMessage:$m}'

jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty" | { c=$(cat); printf "%s" "$c" | grep -q -E "git (commit|tag)|gh (pr|issue|release)" || exit 0; hit=$(printf "%s" "$c" | grep -i -o -E "(Co-authored-by|Signed-off-by|Claude-Session):|Generated (with|by) \\[?Claude|claude\\.ai/code/session_|noreply@anthropic\\.com" | head -1); [ -n "$hit" ] || exit 0; jq -n --arg h "$hit" "{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:\"PreToolUse\",permissionDecision:\"deny\",permissionDecisionReason:(\"Atribución en el mensaje (\" + \$h + \"): este repo no lleva trailers de atribución ni enlaces de sesión en commits, tags, PR ni issues — norma .claude/rules/git.md (D37, D64). Quítalo y repite.\")}}"; }
